name: alamin/minimax-ai-client-devstubs
description: Dev-only install of wordpress/php-ai-client, used solely for PHPStan and PHPUnit. It is NEVER shipped and is NOT registered on the plugin's own autoloader — WordPress core provides WordPress\AiClient\* at runtime, and the root composer.json `replace` keeps the plugin from bundling a colliding copy. See phpstan.neon.dist `bootstrapFiles` and tests/bootstrap.php.
